ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_000
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
是这样啊……
太好了。小香澄，你认真学习了啊

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_001
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
小香澄的考试不要紧吧……
老师说，拿不到及格分不让她回家

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_002
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 啊，来了！小香澄，辛苦你了~！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_003
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 这是在说小纱南他们吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_004
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
呼呼。妹妹吗……
有点羡慕呢

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_005
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
就是因为她太帅气啊~！
我都没有什么可以教给姐姐的东西嘛

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_006
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
唉。虽然我想变得像姐姐那样……
但是还差得远呢~

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_007
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
小香澄……诶嘿嘿。
谢谢你

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_008
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 啊哈哈。就算是商店街也好，能打动他们也很厉害了啊

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_009
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
嗯！
配合得很好，我觉得很棒哦！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_010
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 小沙绫家也会做点什么吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_011
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 说到商店街的祭典，肯定有捏糖人的店吧

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_012
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
我和姐姐一起去过，
很甜很好吃哦

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_013
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 嗯。制作得很好哦，我吃了一惊呢

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_014
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 我记得似乎的确做过肖像糖人哦！

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_015
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
我也觉得很好。
小有咲呢？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_016
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
啊，真的啊。
因为太投入了，时间一眨眼就过去了

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_017
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
诶？
唔，呃，这个……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_018
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 啊，是内容有错误吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_019
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 既然贴了这么多通知，大概没有弄错吧……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_020
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 是啊。为什么取消了呢？

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_021
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
嗯……我在想
祭典为什么取消了

很甜很好吃哦

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_013
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 嗯。制作得很好哦，我吃了一惊呢

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_014
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 我记得似乎的确做过肖像糖人哦！

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_015
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
我也觉得很好。
小有咲呢？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_016
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
啊，真的啊。
因为太投入了，时间一眨眼就过去了

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_017
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
诶？
唔，呃，这个……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_018
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 啊，是内容有错误吗？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_019
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 既然贴了这么多通知，大概没有弄错吧……

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_020
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text: 是啊。为什么取消了呢？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.name: voice_021
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.text:
嗯……我在想
祭典为什么取消了

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_000
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
是这样啊……
太好了。小香澄，你认真学习了啊

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_001
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
小香澄的考试不要紧吧……
老师说，拿不到及格分不让她回家

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_002
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 啊，来了！小香澄，辛苦你了~！

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_003
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 这是在说小纱南他们吗？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_004
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
呼呼。妹妹吗……
有点羡慕呢

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_005
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
就是因为她太帅气啊~！
我都没有什么可以教给姐姐的东西嘛

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_006
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
唉。虽然我想变得像姐姐那样……
但是还差得远呢~

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_007
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
小香澄……诶嘿嘿。
谢谢你

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_008
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 啊哈哈。就算是商店街也好，能打动他们也很厉害了啊

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_009
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text:
嗯！
配合得很好，我觉得很棒哦！

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_010
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 小沙绫家也会做点什么吗？

heart_speech_0_1_1#2.name: voice_011
heart_speech_0_1_1#2.text: 说到商店街的祭典，肯定有捏糖人的店吧
